appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: How this store's customer website looks. Nothing is applied until you save the form.
appearance.resetHint: Goes back to the preset suggested for this category and clears every override. Your brand color is kept.
appearance.brandHint: One color seeds the whole palette — buttons, links, chips, borders and the banner gradient.
appearance.rampCaption: Links, chips and the banner render as {brand}.
appearance.aaManualFail: Your button label choice is below 4.5:1 on this brand ({ratio}:1). It will still apply — consider a darker brand or Auto.
appearance.brandInkHint: Text on primary buttons. Auto picks white or dark for contrast; White/Dark force a choice.
appearance.buttonHint: The solid primary button. Independent of the theme colour, so a black button can sit on a blue site — links, chips and the banner keep the theme colour.
appearance.buttonSourceThemeDesc: Buttons follow the theme colour. The default.
appearance.buttonSourceCustomDesc: Pick a colour for buttons only. Changing the theme colour will not overwrite it.
appearance.buttonInkFail: Label contrast {ratio}:1 — below AA, pick a darker or lighter button
appearance.presetHint: Sets the neutrals, typography and banner style — plus the default corners, shadows, spacing and motion.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.desc: Calm slate neutrals and lots of white space. The safe default.

luxury.label: Luxury
luxury.desc: Warm ink, gold accent, serif headings. Salons, spas, jewellery.

modern.label: Modern
modern.desc: Crisp, tech-forward, high contrast. Agencies and services.

bold.label: Bold
bold.desc: Heavy type, hard edges, thick borders. Gyms and barbershops.

medical.label: Medical
medical.desc: Clean, clinical, unmistakably trustworthy. Clinics and labs.

warm.label: Warm
warm.desc: Soft, appetising, inviting. Restaurants and cafés.

appearance.modeHint: Auto follows each visitor's device setting.
appearance.densityHint: How much breathing room sections and controls get.
appearance.radiusHint: Corner rounding for cards, buttons and images.
appearance.shadowHint: How much cards lift off the page.
appearance.animationHint: Hover and transition feel. Reduced-motion visitors always see less.
appearance.previewHint: This is the real customer website, themed live. Save the form to publish it.
appearance.previewNotResponding: The site loaded but isn't accepting live theme updates. Locally, run the frontend on port 3000 (or set NEXT_PUBLIC_FRONTEND_URL). Save and open the live site to confirm.
appearance.previewUnavailable: The live preview could not load.
appearance.previewDemo: No phone number yet — showing the demo store. Add a phone number to preview this store.
appearance.linkAa: Links {ratio}:1 on the page — passes AA
appearance.linkAaFail: Links {ratio}:1 on the page — below AA, try a darker theme colour
